title: Permission (Role-Based Access)
description: Permission (Role-Based Access) documentation for System Admin.
overview: This guide covers permission (role-based access) workflows for System Admin.

subtasks.title: Review the Role List
subtasks.purpose: See every role defined in the system and its Role Id.

steps.title: Open Roles List
steps.description: Click Permission in the left sidebar — the Roles sub-page opens by default.

steps.title: Sort Roles List
steps.description: Sort by Role Id or Role Name using the arrow indicators in the column headers.

steps.title: Search Roles List
steps.description: Use the Search box to filter by role name.

steps.title: Page Through Roles
steps.description: Use Show entries / pager to navigate long lists. Notes Built-in roles include Super Admin, Admin, Practice Admin, Provider, Practice CareGiver, Patient and System Caregiver. Custom roles (e.g. superadminrole) appear beneath the built-in roles and can be edited or reassigned freely. The Super Admin role has no “assign user” icon because it is provisioned during initial system setup only.

subtasks.title: Add a new role
subtasks.purpose: Create a custom role with its own permission set.

steps.title: Select Module Permissions
steps.description: Select the module-level permissions (View, Create, Edit, Delete) for every applicable module.

steps.title: Save New Role
steps.description: Click Save. Notes Role Ids are assigned automatically and are immutable. Renaming a role does not change the permissions already granted to users holding that role.

subtasks.title: Edit permissions for a role (pencil icon)
subtasks.purpose: Adjust the module-level permissions granted to a role.

steps.title: Open Edit Permissions
steps.description: On the target row, click the green pencil icon in the Action column.

steps.title: Toggle Module Rights
steps.description: On the permissions matrix, tick / untick each module-level right (View, Create, Edit, Delete, Export, etc.).

steps.title: Save Role Permissions
steps.description: Click Save. Notes Removing a permission is enforced immediately — users may see “Access denied” on pages they previously reached. The Super Admin role is intentionally uneditable to prevent lock-out.

subtasks.title: Assign users to a role (assign-user icon)
subtasks.purpose: Grant or revoke a role for specific users.

steps.title: Open Assign Users
steps.description: On the target row, click the person-with-plus icon in the Action column.

steps.title: Search for Users
steps.description: In the assign panel, search for users by name, username or email.

steps.title: Grant or Revoke Role
steps.description: Tick the users to grant the role, or untick to revoke.

steps.title: Save Role Assignment
steps.description: Click Save. Notes A user can hold multiple roles; effective permissions are the union of all held roles. Revoking a role does not delete the user account — it only removes that permission set. 7. Practice Admin Task 7.1 — Dashboard (Practice Landing)
